decisions.reason: As a newly launched custom hearing product close to the firm's existing capabilities, it is still an inexpensive option to keep open while market acceptance becomes clearer.
This product appears strategically emphasized and fits the firm's integrated hearing-systems business, so management would likely continue it while uncertainty is still resolving.

Although equipment products can be costlier to support, this newly launched thermoforming unit matches the firm's manufacturing and laboratory know-how, so the option value of keeping it on the market still outweighs early abandonment.
